events.1: The week passed quietly, with no trouble and no news.
events.2: A dice game sparked a tavern brawl; it ended with curses only.
events.3: A night fight in an alley left you bruised and wounded.
events.4: A petty thief snatched a purse, but you ran him down.
events.5: A local merchant invited you to supper.
events.6: A cold night under open sky sapped your strength: you are fatigued.
events.7: Strange rumours of cultists drift through the market.
events.8: An old acquaintance is back in town and seeks your company.
events.9: A vicious brawl with a street gang left deep wounds.
events.10: Sudden luck: a lost purse lay on the road, though it was empty.
